resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Lookouts directory's Florida index lists Catledge Hill, but its page names Brooks County, which is in Georgia. The record and the story follow Georgia.

sources.title: Fire towers are fading into history

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Evidence is the tnlandforms list entry (name, county, elevation, coordinates), a directory page that gives only the name and county, and general statewide context. The list's note puts names for towers 1 to 72 on a USGS name database, so this name is probably the map name, but no source confirms it. Elevation unit is not labelled; 206 is read as feet to match the record's 62.8 m. The Forest Lookouts directory's own record for this tower (data/sources/eastern_us_lookouts.json, key eastern_us_lookouts:fl:catledge-hill) says region FL and lat 30.0; that is wrong against the page's Brooks County and should be corrected at source so it does not reach the map as Florida. No source found on build date, design, staffing, status or access. Two searches returned only topo-map and weather pages. The Savannah article was read from a web.archive.org copy because savannahnow.com returned 403.
